closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if no such point exists\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    \n    // Try each unclustered point as a candidate\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        // Skip if already clustered or already in this cluster\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        \n        // Calculate the maximum distance from candidate to all cluster members\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n        \n        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return closest_point;\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    \n    // Add seed point\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n    \n    // Iteratively add closest points\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    \n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n    \n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n        \n        // Try each unclustered point as a seed\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < unclustered_indices.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = }\n        \n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = best_cluster_members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n            \n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < printf(\"Max: %lld\\n\", static_cast<long long>(max_val));\n    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {\n        printf(\"Sample[%zu]: %lld\\n\", indices[i], static_cast<long long>(data[indices[i]]));\n    }\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfzdF2ftF39kNLgDrMciz","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Drw1Fb54fEfr2kamou295y","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261012-111947/qtclustering_claude-haiku-5.5-cc-medium_cuda_r4/qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp","content":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - CUDA Version\n//\n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n//\n// Each round, every unclustered point is tried as a seed on the GPU (one\n// thread block per seed). The seed producing the largest cluster wins, with\n// ties going to the lowest index, as in the sequential algorithm.\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <numeric>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                    \\\n    do {                                                                    \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                          \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                          \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__, \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_));                              \\\n            exit(1);                                                        \\\n        }                                                                   \\\n    } while (0)\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Threads per block; a multiple of the warp size\nstatic constexpr int kThreadsPerBlock = 256;\n// Marks a candidate that can no longer be selected for the current cluster\nstatic constexpr double kDead = HUGE_VAL;\n// Per-seed distance scratch up to this size lives in shared memory\nstatic constexpr size_t kMaxSharedScratchBytes = 48 * 1024;\n// Device memory budget for per-seed working storage\nstatic constexpr size_t kSeedStorageBudgetBytes = size_t(512) << 20;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\n__host__ __device__ inline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Keep the (value, index) pair with the smaller value, ties going to the lower index\n__device__ inline void keepBetter(double& val, int& idx, double other_val, int other_idx) {\n    if (other_val < val || (other_val == val && other_idx < idx)) {\n        val = other_val;\n        idx = other_idx;\n    }\n}\n\n// Warp-wide reduction of (value, index) pairs; the result is valid in lane 0\n__device__ inline void warpArgmin(double& val, int& idx) {\n    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {\n        keepBetter(val, idx,\n                   __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, val, offset),\n                   __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, idx, offset));\n    }\n}\n\n// Grow the candidate cluster for seeds[blockIdx.x]. This is the same greedy growth as\n// the sequential algorithm, with two changes that do not alter the result:\n//  - maxd[c] (max distance from candidate c to the members) is updated incrementally\n//    as each member is added, rather than recomputed against all members. A max over\n//    the same set of distances gives the same value in any order.\n//  - A candidate whose maxd reaches the threshold is retired. maxd never decreases,\n//    so a retired candidate could never be selected later.\n// The candidate scan and the argmin are split across the threads of the block.\ntemplate <bool kSmemScratch>\n__global__ void growClusters(const Point* points, const int N, const int* seeds,\n                             const unsigned char* clustered, const double threshold,\n                             double* scratch, int* members_out, int* cardinality_out) {\n    extern __shared__ double smem_maxd[];\n    __shared__ double warp_val[kThreadsPerBlock / 32];\n    __shared__ int warp_idx[kThreadsPerBlock / 32];\n    __shared__ int next_member;\n\n    double* maxd = kSmemScratch ? smem_maxd : scratch + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * N;\n    int* members = members_out + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * N;\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int lane = tid % 32;\n    const int warp = tid / 32;\n\n    // Already clustered points are never candidates; the others start at distance 0\n    for (int c = tid; c < N; c += blockDim.x) {\n        maxd[c] = clustered[c] ? kDead : 0.0;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    int count = 0;\n    int member = seeds[blockIdx.x];\n    while (true) {\n        if (tid == 0) members[count] = member;\n        ++count;\n\n        // Fold the new member into every live candidate and find the best candidate\n        const Point pm = points[member];\n        double best_val = kDead;\n        int best_idx = INT_MAX;\n        for (int c = tid; c < N; c += blockDim.x) {\n            if (c == member) {\n                maxd[c] = kDead;\n                continue;\n            }\n            double d = maxd[c];\n            if (d == kDead) continue;\n            d = fmax(d, distance(points[c], pm));\n            if (d >= threshold) {\n                maxd[c] = kDead;\n                continue;\n            }\n            maxd[c] = d;\n            if (d < best_val) {\n                best_val = d;\n                best_idx = c;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Block-wide argmin: smallest diameter, then lowest index\n        warpArgmin(best_val, best_idx);\n        if (lane == 0) {\n            warp_val[warp] = best_val;\n            warp_idx[warp] = best_idx;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (warp == 0) {\n            const int num_warps = blockDim.x / 32;\n            best_val = lane < num_warps ? warp_val[lane] : kDead;\n            best_idx = lane < num_warps ? warp_idx[lane] : INT_MAX;\n            warpArgmin(best_val, best_idx);\n            if (lane == 0) {\n                next_member = (best_val < threshold) ? best_idx : -1;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        member = next_member;\n        if (member < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n    }\n\n    if (tid == 0) cardinality_out[blockIdx.x] = count;\n}\n\n// Largest pairwise distance within each cluster, one block per cluster.\n// Thread t handles rows t, t+blockDim, ... of the pair matrix, so each pair is visited once.\n__global__ void clusterDiameterKernel(const Point* points, const int* members,\n                                      const int* offsets, double* diameters) {\n    __shared__ double warp_max[kThreadsPerBlock / 32];\n\n    const int c = blockIdx.x;\n    const int begin = offsets[c];\n    const int size = offsets[c + 1] - begin;\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int lane = tid % 32;\n    const int warp = tid / 32;\n\n    double max_dist = 0.0;\n    for (int i = tid; i < size; i += blockDim.x) {\n        const Point pi = points[members[begin + i]];\n        for (int j = i + 1; j < size; ++j) {\n            max_dist = fmax(max_dist, distance(pi, points[members[begin + j]]));\n        }\n    }\n\n    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {\n        max_dist = fmax(max_dist, __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, max_dist, offset));\n    }\n    if (lane == 0) warp_max[warp] = max_dist;\n    __syncthreads();\n    if (warp == 0) {\n        const int num_warps = blockDim.x / 32;\n        max_dist = lane < num_warps ? warp_max[lane] : 0.0;\n        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {\n            max_dist = fmax(max_dist, __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, max_dist, offset));\n        }\n        if (lane == 0) diameters[c] = max_dist;\n    }\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    if (N == 0) return clusters;\n\n    // Seeds processed concurrently: each needs N member slots, plus N distance slots\n    // in global memory when they do not fit in shared memory\n    const bool use_smem = static_cast<size_t>(N) * sizeof(double) <= kMaxSharedScratchBytes;\n    const size_t bytes_per_seed = N * sizeof(int) + (use_smem ? 0 : N * sizeof(double));\n    const int batch = static_cast<int>(std::max<size_t>(\n        1, std::min<size_t>(N, kSeedStorageBudgetBytes / bytes_per_seed)));\n\n    Point* d_points = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* d_clustered = nullptr;\n    int* d_seeds = nullptr;\n    int* d_members = 0;"," }"]}],"originalFile":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - Simplified Sequential Version\n// \n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if no such point exists\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    \n    // Try each unclustered point as a candidate\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        // Skip if already clustered or already in this cluster\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        \n        // Calculate the maximum distance from candidate to all cluster members\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n        \n        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return closest_point;\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    \n    // Add seed point\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n    \n    // Iteratively add closest points\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        // Find closest point to current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n        const int closest = findClosestPoint(members, clustered, in_cluster, points, \n                                             threshold, point_count);\n        \n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n        \n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n    \n    // Copy members if requested\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n    \n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    \n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n    \n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n        \n        // Try each unclustered point as a seed\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < unclustered_indices.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            if (clustered[seed]) continue;\n            \n            std::vector<int> candidate_members;\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, points, \n                                                       threshold, N, \n                                                       &candidate_members);\n            \n            if (cardinality > max_cardinality) {\n                max_cardinality = cardinality;\n                best_seed = seed;\n                best_cluster_members = candidate_members;\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = best_cluster_members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n            \n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n                clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            }\n            \n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            // No more clusters can be formed\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n    \n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n    \n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        \n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]], \n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        \n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", \n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n        \n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", \n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n    \n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\", \n               num_points, threshold);\n        return 1;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n    printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Generate synthetic data\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n    \n    // Perform QT clustering\n    auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold);\n    \n    auto cluster_end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto cluster_time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(\n        cluster_end - cluster_start);\n    \n    printf(\"Clustering time: %ld ms\\n\", cluster_time.count());\n    printf(\"Clusters found: %zu\\n\", clusters.size());\n    \n    // Calculate statistics and performance metrics\n    int total_clustered = 0;\n    int max_cluster_size = 0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters.size(); ++i) {\n        const int size = static_cast<int>(clusters[i].members.size());\n        total_clustered += size;\n        max_cluster_size = std::max(max_cluster_size, size);\n    }\n    \n    const double avg_cluster_size = clusters.empty() ? 0.0 : \n        static_cast<double>(total_clustered) / clusters.size();\n    \n    printf(\"Points clustered: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\\n\", \n           total_clustered, num_points, \n           100.0 * total_clustered / num_points);\n    printf(\"Average cluster size: %.2f\\n\", avg_cluster_size);\n    printf(\"Maximum cluster size: %d\\n\", max_cluster_size);\n    \n    // Performance metrics\n    const double time_sec = cluster_time.count() / 1000.0;\n    const double clusters_per_sec = clusters.size() / time_sec;\n    const double points_per_sec = num_points / time_sec;\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfzfH5vdTAyK16Skwkk7R","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The clustering now runs on the GPU and produces output identical to the original on every configuration I could check. At 1000 points, clustering time drops from 7024 ms to about 17 ms.\n\n**What changed** (only `qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp` and `qtclustering/CMakeLists.txt`; no new files, executable name unchanged):\n\n- **Seed-level parallelism:** each round, every unclustered seed grows its candidate cluster in its own thread block. The seed with the largest cluster wins, with ties going to the lowest index, as before.\n- **Incremental distances:** the original recomputed each candidate's max distance to all members at every step. The kernel updates it once per added member. A max over the same distances gives the same value in any order, so results don't change. This alone removes a factor of the cluster size from the work.\n- **Retiring candidates:** a candidate whose max distance reaches the threshold can never be selected later, so it is marked dead and skipped.\n- **Block argmin:** the candidate scan and the minimum search are split across the block's threads and reduced with warp shuffles.\n- **Validation on GPU:** the per-cluster diameter check (`-v`) is a kernel too. Output and PASS/FAIL logic are unchanged.\n- **Build:** the project now enables the CUDA language, and the `.cpp` is compiled by nvcc via `set_source_files_properties(... LANGUAGE CUDA)`. Host flags go through `-Xcompiler`. Minimum CMake is 3.24, and architectures default to `native`.\n- The old CPU clustering functions are removed, since the program now always uses the GPU path.\n\n**Verification:**\n- I built the original in `/tmp` as a baseline. Outputs (including membership hashes and validation) are identical for `-n 100`, `-n 1000`, `-n 1000 -t 0.5`, `-n 300 -t 1e9`, `-n 300 -t 0.001`, and `-n 500 -t 3.0`, all with `-r -v`.\n- The shared-memory path is the default for N ≤ 6144. I also built a scratch copy in `/tmp` that forces the global-memory path and small batches; it reproduced the same hashes.\n- The build compiles with no warnings under `-Wall -Wextra`.\n\n**Caveats:**\n- Timing excludes CUDA context creation. I call `cudaFree(nullptr)` before the timer starts. Host-to-device and device-to-host copies are inside the timed region.\n- The original generator hangs forever for N ≤ 30, because `group_cnt` is always 0 there. The new program behaves the same. I left it alone, since changing it would change the generated data.\n- I did not time the original at sizes beyond 1000, so I have no baseline speedup numbers for larger N.\n- I made no git commit, since you didn't ask for one."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1134,"cache_read_input_tokens":81046,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1134},"output_tokens":6,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"921eb848-66d0-40f6-b29d-8e797c68c24c","uuid":"9b93cda9-2b70-4116-b1e4-c0dad14327c2","timestamp":"2026-10-13T17:51:20.743Z","request_id":"req_011CfzfH5cmyvueMcW1qP8om"}
